scope: P0/P3 implementation: evidence identity, bounded recovery search and explicit claim decision; no experimental replay
allowed_claims: The historical manuscript reports a 21,840-row extractive experiment and a separate 3,016-row repetition/accepted-label experiment.
The canonical source tables and current workbench are publicly available at the specified commit, with independent input reconstruction documented in the prior audit.
The exact completed principal/repetition archives were not recovered from the bounded accessible repository search, so their historical numerical outcomes are not independently re-established here.
An explicitly new A-prime reimplementation may be performed if scientifically needed; it must name its code, input, config and deviations and cannot substitute for the missing historical archive.
disallowed_claims: All historical results were freshly reproduced or independently certified.
Current workbench source is the original principal runtime because counts and backend families resemble the paper.
The 1,092-row diagnostic reproduces the 21,840-row principal or the 3,016-row repetition experiment.
No original archive exists anywhere, was destroyed, or can never be recovered.
A hash mismatch caused solely by LF/CRLF differences proves source-data tampering.
branch_if_original_archive_later_supplie: verify original file hashes and run identity
execute exact historical version only if possible as H3, documenting environmental differences

branch_if_new_A_prime_scientifically_nee.label: A-prime new reimplementation
branch_if_new_A_prime_scientifically_nee.requirement: Freeze before executing; identical row count does not imply an identical experiment.

repetition_gap: If original repetitions are not recovered and the separately designed fixed-target Study C dose module is not executed, the repetition analysis remains an explicit unresolved gap; reducing claims does not complete an unperformed experiment.

evidence.meaning: Explicitly distinguishes the supplied historical manuscript from current code and says full historical archives are not bundled.
Current workbench defaults and Git-ignored generated run directories.
results/runs/ excluded; explains publication practice, not independent proof of nonexistence.
Historical run ID and reported metrics; not its raw execution archive.
Previously completed independent reconstruction and provenance checks of available canonical inputs.
Fresh repository metadata and verified complete trees used in the bounded search.

human_review.owner_latest_requirement: Keep genuine human semantic validation as pending work; do not present AI review or blank forms as a substitute.
